'''Daniel Starr Scum And Villiany''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Daniel Starr]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-13990">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/13990 Scum And Villiany], DeckTech (Daniel "Dstarr05" Starr, 24 February 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/13990/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/13990/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018043350/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/13990/ Wayback Machine].</ref>
